variants.title: J · Arquitectura diagonal
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity desktop website HERO proposal for IMSS JSDP Sonora, an institutional staff-development intranet in Mexico. Landscape 1600x1000, full screen edge-to-edge, no device or browser frame. Render only header and hero with crisp readable Spanish text.
Reference 1 is the official IMSS logo. Preserve its indivisible stacked shape: emblem above IMSS letters, exact proportions and green, on white. Shared white header: logo at left, thin muted-gold divider, name "JSDP Sonora"; nav "Inicio", "Conoce la JSDP", "Estructura", "Documentos"; dark-green "Iniciar sesión" button.
Exact hero copy: identity "JSDP · Sonora"; heading "Jefatura de Servicios de Desarrollo de Personal"; body "Órgano de Operación Administrativa Desconcentrada Sonora del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social."; primary action "Conoce la JSDP" plus right arrow.
Visual family: elegant Patria-like serif headline, simple sans-serif body, forest green #0b503e, white, restrained muted gold. Use supplied project photos faithfully. No invented people, buildings, metrics, slogans, claims, services or extra controls. No giant repeated logo or proposal labels inside the screen. Strong hierarchy and generous margins.
DIRECTION J: a dynamic but dignified architectural hero. One broad WHITE text field occupies the left and one edge-to-edge crop of the office-building photograph in reference 2 occupies the right. A single clean diagonal seam divides white and photo; it leans gently through the middle, with a restrained thin gold accent following its edge. Keep the headline, body and green button comfortably within the white field, never crossing the seam. Photo fills the full hero height below the header; retain the facade entrance, blue windows and palms. No floating panel, shadow, circular crop, collage or map. The diagonal is the signature composition, with quiet flat surfaces everywhere else.
